title: fix(rest,runtime)!: seeing a datasource's remote structure needs the read capability on every route, writes included
body:
Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — `POST /api/v1/datasources/:name/external/refresh-catalog`, `POST /api/v1/datasources/:name/external/tables/:remote/import` and the MCP `import_object` tool now require `manage_platform_settings` as well as `manage_metadata`; `@objectstack/rest` adds two exports, `federationCapabilityRefusal` and the type `FederationCallKind`.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill or doc page states which capability the federation routes require; the one agent-facing text that does, the MCP `import_object` tool description, is updated in this diff.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:联邦数据源的两个写接口(刷新目录 `refresh-catalog`、导入为对象 `import`)与 MCP 的 `import_object` 工具,现在除 `manage_metadata` 外还要求 `manage_platform_settings`;这条规则只写在一处(`federationCapabilityRefusal`),REST 与 MCP 都调用它。
- **为什么改**:维护者裁决「两个写接口同时要求读权限 (Recommended)」——看到数据源的远端结构在每条路由上都需要读权限,写接口也不例外。
- **风险与回滚**:这是收窄(BREAKING):只有 `manage_metadata`、没有 `manage_platform_settings` 的凭据调用这两个写接口改为 403。内置的 `admin_full_access` 两项都有,不受影响;Studio 数据源页本来就要求读权限才能列表和起草,导入流程不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:① `packages/rest/src/external-datasource-routes.ts` 的 `federationCapabilityRefusal` 与 `refuseFederationRequest` 中调用它的那几行;② `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` 的 `federationPairCallable` / `federationService`;③ `packages/qa/dogfood/test/external-federation-read-capability.dogfood.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --project local src/external-datasource-routes-auth-guard.test.ts`,预期 `Tests 12 passed (12)`,其中「`manage_metadata` alone is refused all five」一条通过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地(收窄已申报,契约档复核由席位执行)。

## What changes

The rule: **seeing a datasource's remote structure needs the read capability on every route, writes included.** Maintainer ruling, 2026-11-03 (verbatim: 「两个写接口同时要求读权限 (Recommended)」).

- `packages/rest/src/external-datasource-routes.ts` — the federation family's capability decision moves into one exported function, `federationCapabilityRefusal(kind, held)`. A `'read'` requires `FEDERATION_READ_CAPABILITY` (`manage_platform_settings`); a `'write'` requires it AND `FEDERATION_WRITE_CAPABILITY` (`manage_metadata`). The refusal names every capability the caller lacks, read first, so a caller lacking only the read capability gets the read routes' own refusal on a write route: `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, same message. `refuseFederationRequest` calls it; it still runs before the service lookup, so a refused import saves nothing. The two constants' docblocks state the rule and the ruling.
- `packages/rest/src/index.ts` — exports `federationCapabilityRefusal` and `FederationCallKind`, beside the two constants already exported for the MCP bridge.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` — the MCP federation bridge asks the same function per call (`federationService`), and carries the `list_remote_tables` / `import_object` pair only where some call of it can pass (`federationPairCallable`, the existing listing rule). An envelope holding `manage_metadata` without `manage_platform_settings` can pass neither call, so it is carried neither tool, as an envelope holding neither capability already was.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` — the `import_object` tool description and the bridge docblock say the import requires the read and write capabilities.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` — the note on why `external_catalog` has no `/meta` WRITE row stays true: the row matches the write door's capability for the write (`manage_metadata`, unchanged); the read capability the refresh now also requires is for what it answers, and the `/meta` write doors answer a receipt, never the stored document. No row changes.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/integration-system.json` — the two federation items' clauses that said the writes sit on `manage_metadata` alone now name both capabilities (history entries added).
- `.changeset/federation-writes-read-capability.md` — patch on `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/mcp`, BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

Before: the refresh and the import required `manage_metadata` only. Now: they require `manage_metadata` and `manage_platform_settings`. The three read routes, the anonymous floor and the ADR-0069 posture gate are unchanged.

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/external-datasource-routes-auth-guard.test.ts` — the route table lists every capability a route requires (`READS` / `WRITES`). The case that pinned "`manage_metadata` alone clears the writes" is FLIPPED, not deleted: `seeing remote structure needs the read capability on every route, writes included: manage_metadata alone is refused all five, the writes with the read routes' status and code`, which also asserts no service ran and the service was never looked up. New control: `…and holding both capabilities clears the writes`. The holding-nothing case now asserts both capabilities are named on a write route.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-federation-bridge.test.ts` — the import is served for a holder of both capabilities; a holder of the write capability alone is carried neither call (two cases, one on a hand-built envelope, one on the envelope the real `/mcp` door resolves); a holder of the read capability alone keeps the pair, its listing served and its import refused `403`.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/external-federation-read-capability.dogfood.test.ts` (new) — the HTTP door on the composed showcase with `ExternalDatasourceServicePlugin`, grants authored at runtime through `/meta/permission`: a member holding `manage_metadata` alone is refused the refresh and the import with the status and code `GET …/external/tables` answers it, the refused import leaves no object (`GET /meta/object/:name` answers `404`); control, a member holding both capabilities, gets `200` with a non-empty catalog, `201` for the import, and its object reads back `200` through the same door.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-type-write-capability.test.ts` — one test title updated to match the note; no assertion changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Public surface.** `@objectstack/rest` gains two exports; measured on the built `packages/rest/dist/index.d.ts` (`declare function federationCapabilityRefusal`, `type FederationCallKind`, both in the export list). That is why the declaration reads `yes (narrowing)` rather than `no (narrowing)`.
- **Studio.** The datasource page's import flow lists (`GET …/external/tables`) and drafts (`POST …/draft`) before saving through `PUT /meta/object/:name`; it never calls the `/import` route, and both of those reads already required `manage_platform_settings`. Its Refresh-catalog button now needs the same capability its table listing already needed. No stock permission set grants `manage_metadata` without `manage_platform_settings` (`admin_full_access` grants both; the organization-admin sets grant neither).
- **Other doors into the same operations.** The admin spelling (`service-datasource` `admin-routes.ts`) requires `manage_platform_settings` on all eleven routes, unchanged. The SDK (`datasources.external.*`) and the CLI are clients of the REST routes and change with them.
- `pnpm test:repo` (the vitest `repo` project) is not run locally; it belongs to CI's `Test Core`.
